title: 铅笔写的满分  (Ten Out of Ten in Pencil)

segments.t: In the café corner, the scent of wildflowers and toasted almonds fills the air. Mei carries Tin Three to the counter, where Chen and Qing wait eagerly with forks in hand. Listen first.
老陈、小晴，三号盘的莓果杏仁蛋糕烤好啦！
上面刷着温蜂蜜和甜橙皮丝，看起来金光闪闪的！
这次我必须先看清周经理在不在旁边，再动叉子。
放心吧，这是宋老师亲自解开的菜谱，绝对甜进心里！
老陈已经咬了一大口——他闭上眼睛，一点声音都没发出来。
老陈？不会是蜂蜜加得太多，把牙齿粘住了吧？
太完美了……这味道简直像回到了三十年前的阳光房！
看，老陈翻开前台的纸本子，用铅笔在角落画了什么？
我看看——十分！老陈用铅笔写了个大大的十分！
大厨，这满分蛋糕只吃一块可停不下来，再给我切一片！
真不敢相信，三十年前的时间胶囊里，藏着这么棒的菜谱！
既然蛋糕这么成功，我们也给院子里的兄弟俩送去吧！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈、小晴，三号盘的莓果杏仁蛋糕烤好啦！
'Chen, Qing, the berry-and-almond cake in Tin Three is finished baking!' "Kao hao" literally anchors the line with "bake" and "good" for "successfully finished".
上面刷着温蜂蜜和甜橙皮丝，看起来金光闪闪的！

'Brushed with warm honey and sweet orange zest on top, it looks sparkling and golden!' "Shua zhe" literally indicates the honey is currently "brushing" the surface, and "jinguang shanshan" describes flashing golden light.
这次我必须先看清周经理在不在旁边，再动叉子。
'This time I must first check clearly if Manager Zhou is nearby before moving my fork.' "Bixu" literally delivers an urgent "must", and "zai... pangbian" places him "at... the side".
放心吧，这是宋老师亲自解开的菜谱，绝对甜进心里！

'Rest assured, this is the recipe Teacher Song solved in person, guaranteed to be sweet right to your heart!' "Fangxin" literally tells Chen to "put his heart down" and relax, while "qinzi" literally means "in person / personally".
老陈已经咬了一大口——他闭上眼睛，一点声音都没发出来。
'Chen has already taken a big bite—he closed his eyes and has not made a single sound.' "Yidian shengyin dou" literally emphasizes "even a little bit of sound... all", meaning absolute silence.
老陈？不会是蜂蜜加得太多，把牙齿粘住了吧？
'Chen? Could it be that too much honey was added and stuck your teeth together?' "Zhan zhu" literally locks "stick" with "firm / halt", suggesting his jaw is glued shut.
太完美了……这味道简直像回到了三十年前的阳光房！
'Too perfect... this flavour is simply like returning to the sunroom thirty years ago!' "Jianzhi" literally intensifies the feeling as "simply / virtually", painting a vivid trip back in time.
看，老陈翻开前台的纸本子，用铅笔在角落画了什么？

'Look, Chen opened the front desk paper ledger and drew something in the corner with his pencil?' "Fan kai" literally joins "flip" and "open", and "benzi" is the everyday noun for a notebook or ledger.
我看看——十分！老陈用铅笔写了个大大的十分！
'Let me take a look—ten points! Chen wrote a massive ten points with his pencil!' Doubling "da" into "dada de" gives a child-like, joyful emphasis to the "massive" score.
大厨，这满分蛋糕只吃一块可停不下来，再给我切一片！
'Chef, one piece of this full-score cake is impossible to stop at; cut me another slice!' "Ting bu xialai" literally wraps "stop" in negative potential, meaning "unable to come to a halt".
真不敢相信，三十年前的时间胶囊里，藏着这么棒的菜谱！

'I really cannot dare to believe it; such an amazing recipe was hidden inside the time capsule from thirty years ago!' "Bu gan" literally humbly "dare not" believe the outcome, and "bang" is the everyday spoken word for "excellent / amazing".
既然蛋糕这么成功，我们也给院子里的兄弟俩送去吧！
'Since the cake is so successful, let us send some out to the brothers in the courtyard, too!' "Jiran" literally sets up the "since..." premise, leading to the action of "song qu" ("send out").
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
老陈、小晴，三号盘的莓果杏仁蛋糕烤好啦！
上面刷着温蜂蜜和甜橙皮丝，看起来金光闪闪的！

真不敢相信，三十年前的时间胶囊里，藏着这么棒的菜谱！
既然蛋糕这么成功，我们也给院子里的兄弟俩送去吧！
Chen eagerly accepts his second slice, the pencil score shining on the ledger page. One last puzzle piece remains outside! See you next time.
下次见！
